chunks: So I call to witness the rain-producing sky,

key_terms.الرَّجْعِ: The act of returning, bringing back, or echoing; here referring to the periodic return of rain

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Dhat al-Raj'' mean in the context of the sky in Shia exegesis?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath underscores the sky's dynamic capacity for 'reg''—the return of rain or the echo of thunder—as a tangible sign of Allah's power to resurrect the dead. It connects the physical phenomenon of life-giving precipitation with the metaphysical reality of the Day of Judgment, affirming divine authority over both nature and the afterlife.
